sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中走过七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星的彼端有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛里最棒的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个锅搞定的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com斜杠subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布里纳·塔韦尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A terrorist attack on a concert hall near Moscow Friday night killed more than 100 people and injured scores more.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，莫斯科附近一家音乐厅发生了一起恐怖袭击，造成100多人死亡，数十人受伤。

sentences.en: It was the deadliest attack in Russia in decades.
sentences.zh: 这是俄罗斯几十年来最致命的袭击。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Anton Trinovsky on the uncomfortable question it raises for Russia's president, Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事安东·特里诺夫斯基将探讨这为俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京带来的一个令人不安的问题。

sentences.en: Has his focus on the war in Ukraine left his country more vulnerable to other threats?
sentences.zh: 他对乌克兰战争的关注是否让他的国家面对其他威胁时更加脆弱？

sentences.en: It's Monday, March 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月25日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Anton, tell us about this horrific attack in Russia.
sentences.zh: 那么安东，跟我们讲讲俄罗斯这起骇人听闻的袭击吧。

sentences.en: When did you first hear about it?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候第一次听到这个消息的？

sentences.en: So it was Friday night around 8.30 Moscow time that we started seeing reports about a terrorist attack at a concert hall just outside Moscow.
sentences.zh: 那是莫斯科时间周五晚上8点30分左右，我们开始看到有关莫斯科郊外一家音乐厅发生恐怖袭击的报道。

sentences.en: I frankly wasn't sure right at the beginning how serious this was because we have seen quite a lot of attacks inside Russia over the last two years
sentences.zh: 坦白说，一开始我并不确定这有多严重，因为在过去两年里我们在俄罗斯境内看到了相当多的袭击

sentences.en: since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and it was hard to make sense of right away.
sentences.zh: 自从乌克兰全面入侵以来，这在一开始很难让人理清头绪。

sentences.en: But then, within a few hours, it was really looking like we were seeing the worst terrorist attack in or around the Russian capital in more than 20 years.
sentences.zh: 但随后，在短短几小时内，情况真的很像是我们看到了20多年来俄罗斯首都或周边最糟糕的恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: On Friday night, Krakis City Hall was the venue for a concert by an old-time Russian rock group called Picnic.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，克罗库斯城音乐厅是俄罗斯一支老牌摇滚乐队“野餐”音乐会的举办地。

sentences.en: It was a sold-out show.
sentences.zh: 这是一场门票售罄的演出。

sentences.en: Thousands of people were expected to be there.
sentences.zh: 预计有数千人会到场。

sentences.en: And before the start of the concert, it appears that four gunmen in camouflage walked into the venue and started shooting.
sentences.zh: 而在音乐会开始前，似乎有四名身穿迷彩服的枪手走进场馆并开始开枪。

sentences.en: We started seeing videos on social media, just incredibly awful graphic footage of these men shooting concertgoers at point-blank range.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在社交媒体上看到视频，那些画面极其可怕且血腥，这些人在极近的距离向音乐会观众开枪。

sentences.en: In one of the videos, we see one of them slitting the throat of one of the concertgoers.
sentences.zh: 在其中一段视频中，我们看到其中一人正在割断一名音乐会观众的喉咙。

sentences.en: And then what appears to have happened is that they set the concert hall on fire.
sentences.zh: 接下来似乎发生的事情是，他们放火烧了音乐厅。

sentences.en: Russian investigators said they had some kind of flammable liquid that they lit on fire and basically tried to burn down this huge concert hall with wounded people in it.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯调查人员表示，他们有一种易燃液体并将其点燃，基本上是试图烧毁这个装有伤者的巨大音乐厅。

sentences.en: Some of these people ended up trapped as the building burned, as eventually the roof of this concert hall collapsed.
sentences.zh: 随着大楼燃烧，其中一些人最终被困，这座音乐厅的屋顶最终也坍塌了。

sentences.en: And it seems as though much of the casualties actually came as a result of the fire, as opposed to as a result of the shooting.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来，大部分伤亡实际上是火灾造成的，而不是枪击造成的。

sentences.en: The actual attack, it looks like, didn't take more than 15 to 30 minutes, at which point the four men were able to escape.
sentences.zh: 实际的袭击看起来持续时间不超过15到30分钟，随后这四名男子得以逃脱。

sentences.en: They got into a white Renault sedan and fled the scene.
sentences.zh: 他们坐上一辆白色的雷诺轿车逃离了现场。

sentences.en: It took the authorities clearly a while to arrive.
sentences.zh: 显然，当局花了很长时间才赶到。

sentences.en: The attackers were able to spread this horrific violence for, as I said, at least 15 minutes or so.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，袭击者得以将这可怕的暴力持续了至少15分钟左右。

sentences.en: So among other things, there's a lot of questions being raised right now about why the official response took so long.
sentences.zh: 所以除此之外，现在有很多关于为什么官方反应如此迟缓的质疑。

sentences.en: And you said the perpetrators got away.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说凶手逃掉了。

sentences.en: What happened next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So it looks like they were caught at some point hours after the attack.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们在袭击发生几小时后的某个时间点被抓获了。

sentences.en: On Saturday morning, the Kremlin said that 11 people had been arrested in connection to the attack, including all four perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 周六上午，克里姆林宫表示，已有11人因与此次袭击有关而被捕，其中包括全部四名凶手。

sentences.en: They were taken into custody, according to the Russian authorities, in the Bransk region of Russia, roughly a five-hour drive from the concert hall in southwestern Russia,
sentences.zh: 据俄罗斯当局称，他们是在俄罗斯布良斯克地区被拘留的，距离西南部俄罗斯音乐厅的车程大约五个小时，

sentences.en: also pretty close to the border with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 而且离乌克兰边境也挺近。

sentences.en: Obviously, we have to take everything that the Russian authorities are saying with a grain of salt.
sentences.zh: 显然，对于俄罗斯当局所说的一切，我们都必须持保留态度。

sentences.en: And as we've been reporting on this throughout the weekend, we have very much tried to verify all the claims that the Russian authorities are making independently.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在整个周末所报道的那样，我们一直在竭尽全力独立核实俄罗斯当局提出的所有主张。

sentences.en: And so our colleagues in the Visual Investigations Unit of the Times have been working very hard on that.
sentences.zh: 因此，《时报》视觉调查部的同事们一直在为此付出巨大努力。

sentences.en: And what we can say, based on the footage of the attack that was taken by many different individuals and posted to social media,
sentences.zh: 我们可以根据许多不同个人拍摄并发布到社交媒体上的袭击画面说的是，

sentences.en: it very much looks like the four men who were detained, who Russia says were the attackers, in fact, are the same people who are seen doing the shooting
sentences.zh: 这非常像那四名被拘留的男子，俄罗斯称他们是袭击者，事实上，他们就是那些在视频中看到开枪的人

sentences.en: in those videos of the attack, judging by their clothes, judging by their hairstyle, judging by their build and other identifying characteristics
sentences.zh: 从他们的衣服、发型、体型以及其他我们同事一直在研究的辨识特征来判断

sentences.en: that our colleagues have been looking at.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事一直在查看这些特征。

sentences.en: So it does appear that by Saturday morning, the men who directly carried out this attack had been taken into custody.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来到周六早上，直接实施这次袭击的人已经被拘留了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So the Russian government actually apprehended the perpetrators, according to our reporting work that our colleagues have done.
sentences.zh: 根据我们同事所做的报道工作，俄罗斯政府实际上抓获了凶手。

sentences.en: So who are these guys?
sentences.zh: 那么这些家伙是谁？

sentences.en: We don't know much about them.
sentences.zh: 我们对他们知之甚少。

sentences.en: The Russian government says that none of them are Russian citizens.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府表示，他们都不是俄罗斯公民。

sentences.en: After the arrest throughout the weekend,
sentences.zh: 在整个周末的逮捕行动之后，

sentences.en: videos, short clips of interrogations of these men have been popping up on the Telegram social network, clearly leaked or provided by Russian law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这些男子审讯的短视频片段开始出现在电报社交网络上，显然是由俄罗斯执法部门泄露或提供的。

sentences.en: You see these men bloodied, hurt.
sentences.zh: 你看到这些男子浑身是血、受到伤害。

sentences.en: And is this Russian interrogators abusing them?
sentences.zh: 这是俄罗斯审讯人员在虐待他们吗？

sentences.en: Yes, that is very much what it looks like.
sentences.zh: 是的，看起来非常像这样。

sentences.en: And it's also notable that the Russian authorities aren't even hiding it.
sentences.zh: 而且值得注意的是，俄罗斯当局甚至都没有掩饰这一点。

sentences.en: Two of the suspects in those videos are heard speaking Tajik.
sentences.zh: 视频中的两名嫌疑人听起来在说塔吉克语。

sentences.en: So that's the language spoken in Tajikistan, a Central Asian country, but also in some of the surrounding countries, including Afghanistan, at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 那是塔吉克斯坦（一个中亚国家）以及周边一些国家（包括阿富汗）所说的语言，归根结底，

sentences.en: this is still a very much developing situation.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个高度发展中的局势。

sentences.en: And there's a ton that we don't know.
sentences.zh: 还有大量我们不知道的事情。

sentences.en: But hours after the attack, the Islamic State, ISIS, took responsibility.
sentences.zh: 但在袭击发生几小时后，“伊斯兰国”（ISIS）宣称负责。

sentences.en: And they then really tried to emphasize this by even releasing a video on Saturday showing the attack taking place as it was filmed, apparently, by one of the attackers.
sentences.zh: 然后他们甚至在周六发布了一段视频，极力强调这一点，视频展示了袭击发生的过程，显然是由其中一名袭击者拍摄的。

sentences.en: And U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: intelligence officials have told our colleagues in Washington that they indeed believe this to be true, that they believe that this ISIS offshoot did carry out this attack.
sentences.zh: 情报官员告诉我们在华盛顿的同事，他们确实相信这是真的，他们相信这个ISIS的分支实施了这次袭击。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So the Americans actually think that ISIS, the extremist group that we know so well from Iraq and Syria, carried out this attack.
sentences.zh: 所以美国人真的认为我们在伊拉克和叙利亚非常熟悉的那个极端组织ISIS实施了这次袭击。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And all of this is really remarkable because just a few weeks ago, on March 7th, the United States actually warned publicly that something just like this could happen.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切真的非同寻常，因为就在几周前的3月7日，美国实际上公开警告过可能会发生类似的事情。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: embassy in Moscow issued a security alert urging U.S.
sentences.zh: 驻莫斯科大使馆发布了安全警报，敦促美国

sentences.en: citizens to avoid large gatherings over the next 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 公民在接下来48小时内避免大型集会。

sentences.en: They said that the embassy is monitoring reports that extremists have imminent plans to target large gatherings in Moscow to include concerts.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，大使馆正在监控有关极端分子有切近计划针对莫斯科大型集会（包括音乐会）的报告。

sentences.en: Crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That is a very specific warning.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常具体的警告。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And, of course, the statement mentioned that specific 48-hour time frame, but nevertheless, it feels really significant.
sentences.zh: 而且，当然，这份声明提到了那个具体的48小时时间窗口，但尽管如此，这感觉非常重大。

sentences.en: And did the Russian authorities respond to that?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯当局对此做出回应了吗？g

sentences.en: They did, and frankly, they responded mostly by ridiculing it.
sentences.zh: 他们回应了，坦率地说，他们的回应主要是不屑一顾。

sentences.en: This is all obviously happening against the backdrop of the worst conflict between Moscow and the West since the depths of the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切显然都发生在莫斯科与西方之间自冷战低谷以来最严重冲突的背景之下。

sentences.en: And so Vladimir Putin actually publicly dismissed this warning.
sentences.zh: 因此，弗拉基米尔·普京实际上公开驳回了这一警告。

sentences.en: He called it blackmail in a speech that he gave just three days before the attack last Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 在上周二袭击发生前仅仅三天他发表的一场演讲中，他称之为勒索。

sentences.en: So despite the specificity publicly, at least, the Russian authorities did not take it seriously.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管有具体的公开信息，但俄罗斯当局至少没有把它当回事。

sentences.en: That is remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这太不寻常了。

sentences.en: And so three days later, this huge attack happens.
sentences.zh: 三天后，这场巨大的袭击就发生了。

sentences.en: Where is Putin in all of this?
sentences.zh: 普京在这个过程中在哪里？

sentences.en: And who is he blaming?
sentences.zh: 他在指责谁？

sentences.en: What's his version of events?
sentences.zh: 他的事件版本是什么？

sentences.en: So he's coming off this Russian election season, as you know, where he declared this very stage-managed victory and after that had been taking a victory lap of sorts.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚经历了俄罗斯选举季，如你所知，他在那里宣布了一场高度人为操纵的胜利，并在那之后开始进行某种形式的庆祝。

sentences.en: But Putin doesn't appear on camera until around 19 hours after the attack.
sentences.zh: 但直到袭击发生大约19小时后，普京才在镜头前露面。

sentences.en: At that point, Russian state television airs a five-minute speech by Putin.
sentences.zh: 届时，俄罗斯国家电视台播出了普京五分钟的演讲。

sentences.en: He's sitting at this nondescript desk surrounded by two Russian flags, but it's not clear where he is located at that point.
sentences.zh: 他坐在一个平淡无奇的桌子旁，周围环绕着两面俄罗斯国旗，但目前还不清楚他当时位于何处。

sentences.en: It doesn't look like he's at the Kremlin.
sentences.zh: 看起来他不在克里姆林宫。

sentences.en: And Anton, what does he say?
sentences.zh: 安东，他说什么了？

sentences.en: So he describes the horror of this attack.
sentences.zh: 他描述了这次袭击的恐怖之处。

sentences.en: He declares Sunday a national day of mourning.
sentences.zh: 他宣布星期日为全国哀悼日。

sentences.en: He says the most important thing is to make sure that the people who did this aren't able to carry out more violence.
sentences.zh: 他说最重要的是确保做这件事的人无法进行更多的暴力活动。

sentences.en: He also says that the four men who carried out the attack were captured as they were moving toward Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他还说实施袭击的四名男子是在向乌克兰方向移动时被抓获的。

sentences.en: And he claims that, based on preliminary information, as he put it, there were people on the Ukrainian side who were going to help these men cross the border safely.
sentences.zh: 他声称，根据他所说的初步信息，乌克兰方面有人准备帮助这些人安全越过边境。

sentences.en: And remember, this is an extremely dangerous militarized border given that Russia and Ukraine have been in a state of full-scale war for over two years now.
sentences.zh: 请记住，考虑到俄罗斯和乌克兰已经处于全面战争状态两年多了，这是一个极其危险的军事化边境。

sentences.en: And as he ends the speech, he says that Russia will punish the perpetrators, whoever they may be, whoever may have sent them.
sentences.zh: 他在演讲结束时表示，无论凶手是谁，无论可能是谁派他们来的，俄罗斯都将惩罚他们。

sentences.en: So what's important about all that is first of all that Putin did not mention the apparent Islamic extremist connection here that Western officials have been talking about
sentences.zh: 所有这一切之所以重要，首先是因为普京没有提及西方官员一直在谈论的明显的伊斯兰极端主义联系

sentences.en: and that is in front of all of us given that Islamic State has claimed responsibility for the attack.
sentences.zh: 而且考虑到“伊斯兰国”已经宣称对袭击负责，这就摆在我们所有人面前。

sentences.en: But he does set the stage for blaming Ukraine for this horrific tragedy, even though it seems that Putin and the Russian government may be alone in thinking that.
sentences.zh: 但他确实为将这起可怕的悲剧归咎于乌克兰做好了铺垫，尽管普京和俄罗斯政府可能是唯一这样想的人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一《连线》游戏，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天都创作《拼字蜜蜂》和《字母连词》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com斜杠games开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So Anton, the Islamic State has claimed responsibility for this attack, but Putin ignores that and kind of obliquely points the finger at Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 安东，“伊斯兰国”已经声称对这次袭击负责，但普京忽略了这一点，并且有点含沙射影地将矛头指向乌克兰。

sentences.en: What do we actually know about who did this?
sentences.zh: 关于是谁干的，我们究竟知道什么？

sentences.en: Well, let's start with the group that claimed responsibility for this attack.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们从声称对这次袭击负责的组织开始。

sentences.en: That's ISIS, the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 那是ISIS，“伊斯兰国”。

sentences.en: And in particular,
sentences.zh: 特别是，

sentences.en: U.S.

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都会》（Metro）节目中，我是主持人

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·科尼格（Sarah Koenig），为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都会》（Metro）。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
